# Moon 0.4.6 beta
Orbit’s sidebar summary stays inside the Moon window.
- The summary fits narrow and short windows and follows the sidebar on either edge, including compact and folded layouts. - In short windows, activity scrolls while the tracking switch and See more stay in reach. - Close the summary by clicking outside, pressing Escape or Command-W, or minimizing the window.
Apple silicon, macOS 26 or later. One signed DMG serves installation and in-app updates. This Moon beta is Apple Development signed and is not Apple-notarized. The optional ActivityWatch companion is distributed separately by its authors.
